evidence.title: Republicans sound alarm over hidden midterm stakes that could reshape Supreme Court for decades

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital interview recording or transcript with Bernadette Breslin
occurrences.quote_span: "The Supreme Court as we know it would cease to exist under Troy Jackson, Abdul El-Sayed and James Talarico, who are hell-bent on replacing it with a bloated, lawless body designed to advance Democrats’ socialist agenda," NRSC spokeswoman Bernadette Breslin told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Bernadette Breslin
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital interview recording or transcript with Steve Daines
occurrences.quote_span: If Trump doesn’t have a GOP majority in the upper chamber, he said, "if we have a vacancy, Sotomayor, Clarence Thomas, who knows — we could not, President Trump could not move through a Supreme Court justice."
occurrences.speaker: Steve Daines
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital interview recording or transcript with Steve Daines
occurrences.quote_span: "Without a Republican majority, President Trump will not be able to move his Supreme Court nominee through, and that's a nominee that'll be on the bench for 25 years," Daines said. "We need Republicans to connect those dots. Disgruntled Republicans in Texas, come home and vote for Ken Paxton, because the Supreme Court's on the ballot."
occurrences.speaker: Steve Daines
occurrences.subject: 2026 U.S. Senate midterm election
